name: Franklin Country Club
architects: Wayne Stiles and John Van Kleek (18 holes, early 1920s); later work by Phil Wogan and William F. Mitchell (countryclubmag.com, Golf Digest; unverified)

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, project MA_CentralEastern_2021_B21 (2021 USGS Lidar: Central Eastern Massachusetts, flown 20 Mar - 24 Apr 2021), tiles x30y466 and x30y467 mosaicked and clipped to the world + 100 m by data/franklin/clip_dem.py; EPSG:26919 (NAD83 / UTM 19N), NAVD88 metres; downloaded by the developer 2026-10-19 (GitHub release franklin-data)

laz.source: 2021 USGS Lidar: Central Eastern Massachusetts (NOAA Data Access Viewer dataset 9777, job J1472668), clipped to the course box, classes 2-5 delivered (3-5 used); NAD83(2011) / UTM 19N US survey feet, NAVD88 US survey feet; flown 21 March 2021 (GPS times), leaf-off; ordered by the developer 2026-10-19 (GitHub release franklin-data, ma2021_cent_east_J1472668.zip)
laz.label: 2021 USGS lidar, leaf-off

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (1,419 x 1,637 m) + scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: 1,792 m east-west (186 m each side), 2,048 m north-south (205 m each side; the 2,048 m limit)

scorecard_source: Stymie (stymie.golf/golf-courses/massachusetts/norfolk-county/franklin/franklin-country-club), retrieved 2026-10-19; unverified third-party listing (the club website has no card). Every tee row adds up to its printed total. Conflicts: back-nine stroke indexes differ on OpenGolfAPI and GolfingRecord; OpenGolfAPI gives Blue 72.7/131. Built from the Blue tees only (developer, 2026-10-19).
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (2021 Central Eastern Massachusetts lidar)
notes: Phase 1 decisions (developer, 2026-10-19): Blue tees only; all water red, including Uncas Pond (hole 14 plays over it, outside the boundary: red_water_osm); Uncas Brook modelled as a red penalty area; no internal out of bounds; bayside theme; logo by the design chat. Wind 1-9 mph is the course chat's call for an inland wooded course (Oswego 1-7, Indian Island 2-12). Two ponds inside the boundary mapped only as natural=water (w89790565 by the 18th fairway, w1263089460 between holes 1 and 5) are red penalty areas through red_water_osm (course chat: all water red; otherwise they would play as rough).

drop_trees.reason: course chat 2026-10-19 (for the developer's review): hole 18, 21 m broadleaf 15 m left-front of the Blue tee whose crown (10.4 m radius) reaches 0.5 m over the hole line; a perfect drive straight down the line clipped it (the East Potomac / Tualatin rule that trees must not block normal lines)
